description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git submodule summary' command in a Git repository. It defines various test cases to verify the behavior of submodule summaries, including setup, modification, deletion, and multiple submodules, as well as some edge cases and configurations.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a submodule, commits the changes, and returns the short commit hash.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a new commit with the current staged changes and a message.
